FLOATING TUTOR
Click ‹ › in the amber card: the note moves to each feature AND the camera flies there — zoom into a wing, tilt back for the whole attractor. The trajectory draws itself in on load; ↻ Replay (top-right) restarts it. Bottom-left toggles the VECTOR FIELD on/off. Accent (chat + wordmark) is a tweak — try the swatches.
